html:
Return all signed or unsigned ASCII integer substrings found left to right. A sign immediately before a digit belongs to that integer. Use a regular expression; decimal points simply separate matches.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "x=-12 y=+7 z=003"
  ],
  "expected": [
    -12,
    7,
    3
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "3.5"
  ],
  "expected": [
    3,
    5
  ]
}
Hint

A sign is optional; at least one ASCII digit is required.

Complexity: O(n) time and output space
